sentences.text: Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum was identified as a candidate geroprotective species consistently depleted during aging across both sexes and multiple Chinese cohorts.
In naturally aged mice, oral monotherapy with this species was reported to rescue intestinal homeostasis, mitigate multiorgan inflammaging and extend healthspan.
That study characterised 5-aminovaleric acid betaine as a key metabolite derived from Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum whose levels decline physiologically in aging humans.
A probiotic strain, Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum CL256B, was reported to convert the citrus flavanone glycoside hesperidin to hesperetin via rhamnosidase and glucosidase activities.
In an in vitro faecal fermentation, a jujube pectic polysaccharide modified to a low degree of esterification increased the relative abundance of Bifidobacterium pseudocatenulatum.
